_comment: Printed text is identical to scar_for_a_scar_red, which was converted and verified, so the implementation is copied wholesale rather than re-derived. The card PRINTS GoAgain and the engine applies a printed keyword unconditionally, so the gate was decoration and the card always had go again. loader.conditional_keywords() strips the printed keyword only for a SOURCE_IS_ATTACK-gated grant, which is why the shape matters. WHILE_STATIC rather than TRIGGERED because CR 6.2.3d evaluates a conditional static-continuous effect at all times.
